title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode9 Unseen Star

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Band practice was fun!
Luka joining us was a big surprise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Having both her and Miku really helped us get a lot more out of that practice session, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For sure! Gosh, I can't wait to get better and show off to Shiho and Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I can picture it now! When did they learn to play so well?
I wonder if they'll still let me join...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Your impressions of Shiho have always been spot-on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks! Shiho denies it, but it's a fact!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's meet up for practice again tomorrow. Bye!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Saki makes everything fun, like back in the old days.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I keep thinking that I should tell her what happened when she was away. I just don't know how.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, let's have lunch together. Honami can join us today as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (We were put in different classes from the second year of junior high school. I would go to their classrooms during the lunchbreak, until one day...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I want to eat lunch quickly so I can practice bass.
Don't come over anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(All of a sudden, Shiho didn't want to hang out with us.
She grew more and more distant.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (When I asked her why, she replied that she wanted to be left alone and that was it.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um... You bought some apple pies?
Wait, is that bag ALL apple pies?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... It's so embarrassing. Please don't tell anyone.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I remember you used to get them often.
So you still like them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Saki and I went to Miku's place again today.
We played Untitled, and it took us there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, we decided to start a band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, just the two of you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, but you're welcome to join, if you'd like?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry...
I-I was just on my way to buy something. I'd better go.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: How much longer do I have to keep this up?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't see any stars tonight.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Maybe it's because everyone's not with me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Oh no, I forgot the fifth period is math.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe I can borrow Honami's textbook... Huh?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Why is Honami eating her lunch all alone? She normally
eats with her friends.)

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate A
rows.Line:
Hey, want to go to karaoke after school today?
Everyone else is coming.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate A
rows.Line: Of course not. She's no fun to have around.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I came to ask if I could borrow your math textbook...
But more importantly, are you okay? Did something
happen with your friends?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, nothing of the sort! I just didn't feel like chatting
while eating today, that's all!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Are you sure? If something's wrong, you can talk to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's fine, don't worry about it.
It's really nothing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is it really so wrong to care about others?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Sorry, I was thinking out loud about something. The next
class is starting soon. Here's the math textbook.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. Everything's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(After that, whenever I asked her if she was okay, she'd
find some excuse to slip away.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
If I'd only done something then, maybe things wouldn't
have turned out the way they did...
